title: ARC-Bench: Web Application
summary: Build and evaluate web applications across six ARC-Bench tasks. A complete leaderboard score is calculated only when one submission has a completed run for every task in this competition.
notice: Task packs are ready. Create a submission from this competition page.

tasks.title: 12306 railway travel
tasks.summary:
A railway ticketing system for searching trains, managing traveler information, booking journeys, and paying for tickets.

Dates and times use Asia/Shanghai. The application, client, server and evaluator start at 2026-07-21T00:00:00+08:00; client and server clocks advance together with elapsed time.

tasks.title: BookStack knowledge base
tasks.summary:
A knowledge base for organizing and reading shelves, books, chapters, and pages.

Dates and time-dependent content use UTC and the shared application/evaluator clock 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z.

For session and personal dashboard state: Established through login, opening content, favoriting content, or saving pages/drafts. No private storage injection.

tasks.title: Ctrip travel services
tasks.summary:
A travel services application for account access, flight search and booking, order management, reusable traveler information, flight status, vouchers, and airport guidance.

Dates, voucher eligibility and public countdowns use Asia/Shanghai and the shared application/evaluator clock 2026-07-19T08:00:00+08:00.

Sessions, current search criteria, booking selections and status-search history are established by public UI behavior within each scenario, never injected into storage.

tasks.title: Keep personal note management
tasks.summary:
A personal note management application for creating, editing, organizing, searching, archiving, and deleting notes.

The interface uses en-US. Tested note states are established through normal user actions in a single application instance. No fixed benchmark clock or historical deleted-note seed data is required.

tasks.title: PrestaShop B2C storefront
tasks.summary:
A B2C storefront for browsing products, selecting variants, managing a cart, completing checkout, and managing customer accounts.

Displayed dates use UTC and the shared application/evaluator clock 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z; elapsed time drives carousel behavior.

For verified customers: The scenarios use existing verified customer accounts; account verification is outside scope. Address books start empty; UI setup creates Home where required. The source historical-order account also owns completed delivered historical order. New customer email and profile-next email are initially unused. No initial account cart contains products.

For session, filters, selected combination, cart, checkout and recently viewed state: Produced through the corresponding user interactions. Do not inject storage, cookies or API state.

tasks.title: Stack Overflow developer knowledge sharing
tasks.summary:
A developer question-and-answer platform for discovering, publishing, answering, commenting on, voting on, and managing questions and profiles.

The application, server and evaluator use the fixed UTC time 2026-07-21T12:02:00Z. The expired-comment scenario independently uses fixed UTC time 2026-07-21T12:06:00Z.

For public historical question index: Historical metrics, comment clock, collapsed thread and sort samples cannot be reproduced by a single new UI post. Missing timestamps use 2026-07-15T12:00:00Z. Answered sample questions contain an answer by Helpful User. Only dedicated voting/editing records are mutable; other samples remain public after deletion of any UI-created question.

For accounts, questions, answers, comments and filters: All ordinary mutable source examples are created through UI within each case. Question titles append the automatically generated worker-run identifier, parallelIndex and case slug; registration email is new_stack_user+<suffix>@example.com. Helpers create a question as the named owner, then answers/comments as the named author in separate authenticated browser contexts. Each case owns its objects.

For session, edit draft, search, voting and preferences: Produced only by public interactions. No storage injection or hidden API. Vote effects are relative to the author current public reputation, which may include other independent case contributions.

description_markdown:
## ARC-Bench: Web Application

Build and evaluate reliable web applications across the published ARC-Bench task set. Treat each requirement document as the source of truth and use the test evidence to improve your implementation.
flow: Upload an agent snapshot or select a built-in one.
Compile the large requirement into smaller runnable modules.
Run the GitHub-style and spreadsheet-style tasks in order.
Inspect evidence and refine the system until the output is stable.
rules: Treat the requirement document as the source of truth.
Keep changes small enough to verify each step.
Use the task artifacts to explain what your agent changed.
